description: This Java class 'EntityUtilProperties' provides utility methods for managing entity-related properties, including retrieving, comparing, and setting configuration properties, often with database integration via Delegator and SystemProperty entities.

classes.name: EntityUtilProperties
classes.description: Final utility class providing methods for retrieving and managing entity configuration properties, including database-backed properties and resource bundle handling.

methods.name: getSystemPropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieves property value from database SystemProperty entity, indicating existence and value.

methods.name: propertyValueEquals
methods.description: Checks if property value equals a given string.

methods.name: propertyValueEqualsIgnoreCase
methods.description: Checks if property value equals a given string, ignoring case, with database override.

methods.name: getPropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieves property value with fallback to default, considering database override.

methods.name: getPropertyValueFromDelegatorName
methods.description: Retrieves property value using a delegator name, with fallback to default delegator.

methods.name: getPropertyNumber
methods.description: Retrieves numeric property value with default fallback.

methods.name: getPropertyAsBoolean
methods.description: Retrieves boolean property value.

methods.name: getPropertyAsInteger
methods.description: Retrieves integer property value.

methods.name: getPropertyAsLong
methods.description: Retrieves long property value.

methods.name: getPropertyAsFloat
methods.description: Retrieves float property value.

methods.name: getPropertyAsDouble
methods.description: Retrieves double property value.

methods.name: getPropertyAsBigInteger
methods.description: Retrieves BigInteger property value.

methods.name: getPropertyAsBigDecimal
methods.description: Retrieves BigDecimal property value.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Loads Properties object from resource or URL, with optional database override.

methods.name: setPropertyValue
methods.description: Sets property value in database for a given resource and property ID.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves localized message string, with database override if available.

methods.name: getResourceBundle
methods.description: Loads resource bundle for given resource and locale.

methods.name: createResourceName
methods.description: Creates resource name considering locale and extension removal.

methods.name: isPropertiesResourceNotFound
methods.description: Checks if properties resource is missing for given locale.

methods.name: resolvePropertiesUrl
methods.description: Resolves URL for properties resource considering locale.

methods.name: xmlToProperties
methods.description: Converts XML input stream to Properties object.
